title: fix(plugin-auth): a directory deactivation revokes the user's API keys, and no one restores them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAUvWRKPo4TS8boyLtwkTkt)_

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of #32115 (the API-key half of the "Directory deactivation" item of ruling 6787890900 on #32004; the local-password half is a later step).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:通过目录(SCIM)停用或删除一个用户时,平台吊销这个用户名下的全部 API 密钥,原因记为"被目录停用"。之后目录重新启用这个用户,旧密钥也不会恢复,用户新建一个密钥即可。管理员自己的封禁和解封不变,本地密码这次不动。
- 为什么改:落实 #32004 裁决 6787890900 的"目录停用"一项:SCIM 停用或删除会吊销该用户的密钥,管理员也不能恢复。去掉目录用户的本地密码是后续一步,所以本 PR 写的是 `Part of #32115`。
- 风险与回滚:patch 级。`sys_api_key.revoked_reason` 多了一个选项 `scim_deactivated`(Clause-② 扩展,元数据协议不变),11 种语言都已翻译。如果吊销没有全部完成,停用照常生效,服务器记一条 error 日志并写明补救办法,下一次让该用户保持停用的 SCIM 写入会再跑一遍。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-deactivation-key-revocation.ts`(吊销规则)、`auth-manager.ts` 里 `reconcileScimUserLifecycle` 的停用分支、`api-key-restore-guard.ts`(这个原因谁都不能恢复)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run scim-deactivation-reconcile-user api-key-restore-guard`,预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无。这是 draft,由 security#2 席位审阅、翻 ready 并入队;改动约 850 行,不涉及受管路径。

## What changes

**The rule.** Deactivating a user through SCIM (`active: false`), or deleting one (`DELETE /Users/{id}`), revokes every API key the user owns. Each key row stays, with `revoked: true` and `revoked_reason: scim_deactivated`. A later re-activation lifts the directory's ban and re-arms none of those keys; the person creates a new key. An administrator's own ban and unban are unchanged and leave keys alone. Local passwords are not changed.

- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`
  - New `scim-deactivation-key-revocation.ts`: `revokeDirectoryDeactivatedApiKeys(engine, userId)` revokes the user's keys, writing as the system with the SCIM connection's attribution, and returns how many were and were not revoked. It never throws.
  - `AuthManager#reconcileScimUserLifecycle`: the inactive branch (SCIM `active: false`, and the SCIM delete, which reconciles the user as inactive) runs the revocation after the directory's ban. If it does not finish, the deactivation still lands and one `error` line names the user, the counts and the remedy.
  - `api-key-restore-guard.ts`: rule 1 (restored by no one from a user context) now covers `scim_deactivated` beside `organization_membership_ended`. The owner's Restore and a platform administrator's are both refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, naming the reason and the new-key road.
  - `service-account-lifecycle.ts`: the AI service account door `POST /api/v1/auth/service-account/restore-key` writes as the system, so it applies the guard's rule 1 itself; it now refuses `scim_deactivated` too. The route ledger note says so.
  - Restamping: a key with no reason, `admin_password_reset` or `administrator_suspended` is restamped `scim_deactivated`; a key with `organization_membership_ended` keeps it, since no one restores either.
- `@objectstack/core`: the key door's `403 API_KEY_REVOKED` text for `scim_deactivated` says the key cannot be restored and names the new-key road, and names no restorer.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: `sys_api_key.revoked_reason` gains the option `scim_deactivated` ("Deactivated by the directory"). The column stays readonly and off the ADR-0092 D2 whitelist. The help text names the reason and that no one restores it; every shipped locale carries the option and the help.
- Generated: the tenant-audit census tables count the new write site, and their prose follows.

## Why

Ruling 6787890900 on #32004, item "Directory deactivation": "Deactivating or deleting a user through SCIM revokes that user's API keys, and an administrator cannot restore them. Removing a directory user's local password is a later step."

## Verification

All on head `fc310c98` unless stated.

- New tests (names state the rule):
  - `scim-deactivation-reconcile-user.test.ts`, describe "a directory deactivation revokes the user's API keys, and a re-activation re-arms none of them": deactivate then re-activate (each key `revoked: true` with `scim_deactivated`; the key door refuses with `API_KEY_REVOKED`; the owner's restore is refused; a key minted after re-activation is admitted); the restamp cases; the SCIM delete, including a re-link through the tombstone; CONTROL, an administrator's ban and unban (keys untouched; the door answers `refused:owner_banned`, then admits); a refused revocation write still bans and logs one error.
  - `api-key-restore-guard.test.ts`, describe "a key the directory deactivation revoked is restored by no one from a user context" (6 cases: restamp and idempotence, a counted failure, the owner refused, a platform administrator by grant refused, a re-revoke keeps the reason, the door text).
  - `service-account-lifecycle.test.ts`: "a key the directory deactivation revoked is never restored, not by the owner and not by a platform administrator".
  - `api-key-lifecycle.test.ts` (core): "a key the directory deactivation revoked names no restorer, only the new-key road".
  - `forced-reset-revoke-reason-vocabulary.test.ts`: the option list and the help text.
- Ablation, each run on the commit that added its rule, then restored (`ablation-replace.mjs`, blob back to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - the revocation call replaced by a no-op outcome: the 4 deactivation pins go red, the administrator ban/unban CONTROL stays green;
  - the restore-key door's rule 1 without the new reason: its pin goes red (1 of 29).
- Suites: plugin-auth 266 files, 5,025 passed and 10 skipped (head `c69a8ef8`; on `fc310c98` the 9 touched or neighbouring files, 175 tests, rerun green); core 146 files, 3,369 passed; platform-objects 121 files, 1,955 passed. `typecheck` (with test typecheck) green for all three packages; `pnpm lint` green.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciled 109 derived, 109 run, 0 not measured, every exit code 0, after a full declaration build (`check:dts-closure` 311/311, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` green). `check-i18n-bundles --filter=platform-objects` in sync. `main` merged once before opening.

## Acceptance notes

- **Surface widened, seat-approved.** The order's surface was `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/**` and `.changeset/`. security#2 approved the widening in the seat thread on 2026-11-13 at 05:57Z (decision "A"): the new reason word `scim_deactivated`, `platform-objects` `sys-api-key.object.ts` with its generated i18n bundles, `core` `src/security/api-key.ts` (its refusal text must not offer a restore) and their tests; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; patch changesets on plugin-auth, core and platform-objects. The restamp judgment above was accepted as stated, with the restamp cases and the SCIM delete pinned separately.
- **SCIM delete, measured.** The delete removes the SCIM link and keeps a tombstone; the user row and the user's key rows survive it, and the delete reconciles the user as inactive. So the keys are revoked the same way, and the pin covers it.
- **Remainder:** removing a directory user's local password ("a later step" in the ruling) is not in this PR.
- **Also in `plugin-auth/src`:** the AI service account restore door applies the guard's rules itself because it writes as the system, so it was taught the new reason in the same change, with its own pin and ablation.
- The tenant-audit census docs (`content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`) are regenerated output plus the counts quoted in their prose (310 sites).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
